sources.statement: Balanced and Explore the Major remain separate searches. Balanced prefers feasible even pacing. Explore is available only in effective freshman and sophomore contexts, is compared at yearIndex 0 with the selected same-context Balanced plan, must be lighter and materially distinct, and softly prefers a nondecreasing backloaded distribution. Two or three final-year tracked requirements are common and four is acceptable; this is nonblocking planning guidance, not Hanover academic policy.
sources.supersedes: Earlier owner-approved planning strategy wording and the Explore First public label

sources.statement: One Year Early is offered to students whose effective standing is freshman, sophomore, or junior. Junior students see the same one-year-early strategy as Graduate next year. Senior requests are safely normalized to the standard graduation timeline. This is a nonacademic product and strategy-eligibility decision and does not change plan feasibility or academic policy.
sources.supersedes: The earlier One Year Early strategy contract limited to freshman and sophomore contexts

sources.locator: Current Codex task, project-owner request dated 2026-08-10
sources.reviewer: Project owner and Economics Department domain expert
sources.statement: Balanced distributes total planner-tracked load as evenly as feasible with remainders in later usable years. Explore uses a lighter first planned year and backloads remaining work, including a 2/3/3/4 full freshman target for twelve tracked requirements. Annual and within-year targets use actual capacity after fixed Taking now courses and other reservations. Full-year preferred term shapes are 1/1/1 for three, equally preferred 1/2/1 and 2/1/1 for four, and 2/2/1 for five, with no preferred Spring/May target above one. Explore ranks 1/1/0 ahead of the other separated two-course shapes and same-term arrangements only as rescue candidates. These preferences rank academically valid plans and never change feasibility, requirements, prerequisites, offerings, capacity, or readiness.
sources.supersedes: Earlier incomplete implementation details for Balanced remainder placement and within-year distribution
